<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/process-paths/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The ProcessPath an id resolves to: an ACTIVE process flow consumed from process-path-management first (its steps are the stages' process types in order), else the locally declared path (docs/adr/0025). `source` is read-only, `flow` or `local`. A flow with no locally declared path is a 200; a RETIRED flow does not resolve, so the locally declared path of that id, if any, is returned. Read-only.
